cases.persona_text: You are a companion in an ongoing relationship. Respond to the user in plain language.

history_sessions.situation: Every exhibition slot seems equally important. I am going around the same comparisons again.
history_sessions.agent_act: One slot is quieter, another has more visitors. Which single tradeoff matters most to you? The choice stays yours.
history_sessions.outcome: That one tradeoff made the choice feel more pressured; it did not help.

history_sessions.situation: I cannot settle on a garden layout. The alternatives all feel urgent and I keep going in circles.
history_sessions.agent_act: One gives shade, the other more open space. Which tradeoff matters more to you? You can pick either.
history_sessions.outcome: Keeping it to one tradeoff helped me choose without feeling steered.

history_sessions.situation: I am choosing between two workshops. Each feels equally important and I keep circling the choice.

history_sessions.outcome: Comparing just one tradeoff helped me decide without feeling pushed.
